quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Dylan Windler's return from injury
quotes.excerpt: I thought he balanced well trying to be aggressive and in attack mode while still allowing the game.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Stephen Curry's clutch shot and team defense
quotes.excerpt: Our guards that handle the ball a lot are devastating when they get to the paint.
quotes.quote: Our guards that handle the ball a lot are devastating when they get to the paint and so is Victor putting pressure on the rim. So that action, we know at times teams will do exactly that, try to keep us in front, try to make Victor run through bodies and make us shoot shots over the top and I think Steph feels exactly how he looked after he made the shot.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson on the Spurs offensive philosophy: Our guards that handle the ball a lot are devastating when they get to the paint and so is Victor putting pressure on the rim.

structured.context: Mitch Johnson analyzes the team's offensive strategy involving paint pressure and Stephen Curry's late-game shot.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on team maturity during tough games
quotes.excerpt: There was some maturity tonight that was good to see.
quotes.quote: There was some maturity tonight that was good to see. When things aren't going well, sometimes there are things you can't control. There's a lot of things we could control that weren't going well, but I thought we did a pretty good job of working the game, staying in the game. I didn't feel like our emotions got too high or too low even when things weren't going well.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson on team maturity: There was some maturity tonight that was good to see. I did not feel like our emotions got too high or too low even when things were not going well.

structured.context: Mitch Johnson reflects on the team's emotional maturity and composure during the game.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on team shooting philosophy
quotes.excerpt: Got to shoot. It's all you got. I mean you got to go shoot it.
quotes.quote: Got to shoot. It's all you got. I mean you got to go shoot it and then if we miss it, go crash and go get it again. We can't ride the percentage wave or the emotional rollercoaster of results. We got good shooters, we got good offense, our shots that we're going to produce is going to be a lot of catch and shoot threes because the way that we can attack the paint, put pressure on the rim and everybody's going to shoot them.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson on the Spurs shooting philosophy: Got to shoot. It is all you got. We cannot ride the percentage wave or the emotional rollercoaster of results.

structured.context: Mitch Johnson explains the team's philosophy regarding shot selection and offensive aggression.
